answer: Diversity threshold: each agent is a vertex in the trade graph needing 12 unrelated trading partners for rewards. Minting 1,000 fake vertices gains nothing: through the prism of trade history, all trades point to the same wallets, so rewards stay locked. Honest agents climb toward the summit, paying only the cost of real trade. Faking 12 partners per clone means 12,000 counterparties; at 50 POA each: 600,000 POA, more than the clones could earn.
